info.title: Investment List API
info.description:
### Overview

The **Investment List API** allows you to retrieve tabular, list-based investment data for multiple securities in a single synchronous request. It is designed to power grid and list-based views such as watchlists, comparison tables, and dashboards by returning a flat, consistent dataset across funds, ETFs, and equities.

### Investment Limits

A maximum of **100 investments** per request.

### Data Point Limits

A maximum of **50 data points** per request.

### Authentication API

Retrieve tokens required to authorize calls to the API. See [documentation](https://developer.morningstar.com/direct-web-services/documentation/api-utilities/authentication-api/overview).

changes: Updated schemas to point to data dictionary for input data point values instead of listing data points as enums.

datapoints.description: Lists data points to return. Retrieve valid values programmatically via `GET /direct-web-services/v1/investment-list/data-points`, or browse the full reference in the data dictionary.

languageId.description: Gets or sets the language for the investment list results.

currencyId.description: Gets or sets the currency for the investment list results.

ResponseGetDataPoints.title: ResponseGetDataPoints
ResponseGetDataPoints.description: List of supported data points and associated metadata.

id.description: Investment to query. Accepts performance IDs, ISINs, security IDs, CUSIPs, trading symbols, and Morningstar IDs.

baseCurrency.description: Input base currency used to look up Investment identifier

domicile.description: Domicile used to look up investment. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

exchangeCountry.description: Exchange country used to look up investment. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

exchangeId.description: Exchange identifier used to look up investment.

InputInvestment.description: Investment to query. Investment look up is supported.

OutputDataPointMetadata.title: OutputDataPointMetadata
OutputDataPointMetadata.description: Metadata for an available data point.

name.description: The data point identifier in dot-notation, used as the value in the `dataPoints` request array.

alias.description: An alternative identifier for this data point where one exists. When present, the alias may be used in place of `name` in requests.

type.description: The primitive type of the value returned for this data point.

OutputInvalidInvestments.title: OutputInvalidInvestments
OutputInvalidInvestments.description: Input investment identifiers for which no matching investment was found.

id.description: Indicates identifier value passed in request.

idType.description: Indicates the identifier type passed in request.

performanceId.description: Performance ID (if not passed in request).

baseCurrency.description: Input base currency used to look up investment identifier.

domicile.description: Input domicile used to look up investment identifier.

exchangeCountry.description: Input exchange country used to look up investment identifier.

exchangeId.description: Specifies the exchange identifier used to look up investment.

OutputMetadata.description: Metadata returned in response including information about input investment identifiers for which no results were found.
OutputMetadata.title: OutputMetadata

OutputMetadataMessages.description: Provides information about identifiers for which no results were returned.
OutputMetadataMessages.title: OutputMetadataMessages

Bearer.description: Obtain a token via the Authentication API's `POST /token/oauth` endpoint. Tokens are valid for 60 minutes and reusable across requests.

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample2.description:
“I want to compare what funds are exposed to: equity/bond mix, regions, sectors, market cap."

**Typical Fields**

  - **Reference**
    - Fund Legal Name
    - Global Category
  - **Asset Allocation Mix**
    - Equity Percent
    - Bond Percent
    - Cash Percent
    - Other Percent
  - **Country & Regional Exposure**
    - United States Percent Long Rescaled
    - Greater Europe Percent Long Rescaled
    - Greater Asia Percent Long Rescaled
    - Emerging Percent Long Rescaled
  - **Market Cap Breakdown**
    - Market Cap Large Percent Long Rescaled
    - Market Cap Small Percent Long Rescaled
    - Market Cap Mid Percent Long Rescaled
  - **Sector Exposure**
    - Technology
    - Healthcare

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample1.description:
"I want to compare YTD, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y returns and see as-of dates."

**Typical Fields**

  - **Reference**
    - Name
    - Ticker
    - ISIN
    - Asset Type
    - Currency
  - **Daily Returns**
    - Return Date
    - 1 Day Return
    - 1 Week Return
    - 1 Month Return
    - Year to Date Return
    - 1 Year Return
  - **Trailing Return**
    - As Of Date
    - 1 Month Return
    - 3 Month Return
    - 6 Month Return
    - 1 Year Return
    - 3 Year Return
    - 5 Year Return
  - **Month End Trailing Performance** (optional)
    - Return Date
    - 1 Year Return
    - 3 Year Annualised Return
    - 5 Year Annualised Return

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample3.description:
"I want to see volatility, beta, r-squared, Sharpe/Sortino, tracking error."

**Typical Fields**

  - **Reference**
    - Name
    - ISIN
    - Asset Type
    - Currency
  - **Daily Standard Deviation**
    - As Of Date
    - Standard Deviation 252 Day
    - Standard Deviation 756 Day
  - **Monthly Standard Deviation**
    - As Of Date
    - Standard Deviation 36 Month
    - Standard Deviation 60 Month
  - **Risk Statistics**
    - Beta 3 Year
    - R-Squared 3 Year
    - Sortino Ratio 3 Year
    - Information Ratio 3 Year
    - Tracking Error 3 Year
    - Upside Capture Ratio 3 Year
    - Downside Capture Ratio 3 Year
  - **Risk-Adjusted Metrics**
    - Sharpe Ratio 3 Year

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample4.description:
"I want valuation ratios + quantitative fair value anchors."

**Typical Fields**

  - **Reference**
    - Standard Name
    - ISIN
    - Currency
    - Market Sector Code
    - Market Segment Code
  - **Price**
    - Close Price
    - Close Price Datetime
    - Percent Change
  - **Price Multiples**
    - Price to Earnings Ratio
    - Price to Book Ratio
    - Price to Sales Ratio
    - Price to Cash Flow Ratio
    - Price to Free Cash Flow Ratio
  - **Enterprise Value**
    - Enterprise Value
    - Enterprise Value to EBITDA Ratio
    - Enterprise Value to Revenue Ratio
  - **Quantitative Ratings**
    - Price to Fair Value
    - Valuation Label
  - **Quantitative Fair Values**
    - Fair Value
    - Fair Value Date

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample5.description:
"I want to shortlist funds based on what they are, fees, AUM, and manager."

**Typical Fields**

  - **Reference**
    - Fund Legal Name
    - ISIN
    - Investment Type
    - Domicile
    - Inception Date
    - Base Currency
  - **Fund Attributes**
    - Actively Managed
    - Index Fund
    - Open for Investment
  - **Fees**
    - Total Expense Ratio
    - Gross Expense Ratio
    - Net Expense Ratio
    - Fee Level
  - **Net Assets**
    - Net Assets Date
    - Fund Size
  - **Manager**
    - Manager Name
    - Manager Tenure Average
  - **Month End Trailing Performance** (optional)
    - Year to Date Return
    - 1 Year Return

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample6.description: A maximum of 50 data points can be sent in a single request.

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample7.description: A maximum of 100 investment IDs can be sent in a single request.

RequestRetrieveInvestmentListExample8.description: Results are sorted by `performanceId` in ascending order by default. You can override the default settings by specifing up to two fields to sort results by.
